archetype: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) blended with Medical-Grade Minimalism
design_philosophy: A privacy-first, calming, and clinically clean interface. We avoid heavy dropshadows and borders, utilizing a flat monochrome base with deep calming primary accents (Indigo-Teal). Typography drives visual hierarchy. Every screen must feel secure, objective, and deeply respectful of the user's data.

AuthScreen.elements: Logo/Brand Title, Biometric unlock prompt (FaceID/TouchID icon), PIN pad fallback, 'Medical-grade privacy' disclaimer text.
AuthScreen.visuals: Abstract soft background (cycle_ring_bg image) with glass-like semi-transparent card.

DashboardScreen.layout: Scrollable vertical list. No top app bar, large typographic header.
elements: Header: Greeting & current date
Hero: Cycle Countdown Ring (SVG based, displaying 'Day X', 'Fertile Window in Y days').
Quick Log Actions: Horizontal scroll or bento grid of flat cards for 'Start Period', 'Log Symptom', 'Log Mood'.
Disclaimer text at the bottom: 'Predictions are statistical estimates, not medical certainty.'

CalendarScreen.layout: Standard calendar grid layout over a flat card.
elements: Month toggle controls
7x5 Grid. Days with periods have a #D9534F dot or soft background. Fertile windows have a #5C9EAD dot.
Bottom sheet or list below calendar detailing logged symptoms and moods for the selected day.
List of symptoms (Cramps, Headache, Acne, Fatigue, Bloating, Nausea, Back pain, Breast tenderness).
Severity Selector for each selected symptom: Segmented control (None, Mild, Moderate, Severe).
Journaling text area (TextInput) with tags.
Visibility toggle: 'Private' vs 'Shared with Partner'.
Hero illustration (privacy_shield image).
Generate Time-Limited Token button.
Active Partner List.
Granular Data Toggles: 'Share Cycle Phase', 'Share Moods', 'Share Symptoms'.
Info banner explaining end-to-end encryption or read-only access.

AnalyticsScreen.layout: Dashboard widget layout (Bento grid mode B - 'Control Room')
elements: Averages Card: Cycle length, Period length.
Regularity Score (large typography).
Symptom Frequency Bar Chart (using React Native SVG or Victory Native).
Flat borders, dense data presentation but high contrast.

interactions_and_motion.transitions: React Native LayoutAnimation or Reanimated for smooth, subtle mounting of components.
interactions_and_motion.buttons: Opacity feedback on press (activeOpacity={0.7}). No springy bouncy effects, keep it clinical and precise.

testing_attributes.convention: Use standard React Native `testID` prop on all interactive elements. Follow role-based kebab-case.

images.description: Minimalist medical-grade abstract background, soft calming teal and off-white gradients
images.usage: Use as a full-screen background image (with resizeMode='cover' and low opacity) on the Auth/Onboarding screens.

images.description: Flat minimalist illustration of a safe lock or shield in teal and indigo
images.usage: Use as the hero illustration on the Partner Sharing portal to reinforce trust and security.

images.description: Abstract soft circular ripples in calming teal on a pure white background
images.usage: Use as a background element behind the main cycle countdown ring on the Dashboard.

images.description: Serene teal water surface with ripples
images.usage: Use inside the Journaling feature header to evoke calmness and reflection.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a React Native Expo application. DO NOT use HTML/CSS or Tailwind classes. Translate all design tokens into React Native `StyleSheet` objects.
Follow flat design principles: Do not apply `shadowColor` or `elevation` unless explicitly defining a modal/bottom sheet.
Implement the UI using functional components and hooks.
For the Cycle Countdown Ring and Analytics charts, utilize `react-native-svg` to ensure crisp vector rendering.
Ensure all interactive elements have a `testID` prop to comply with testing rules.
For icons, use `@expo/vector-icons` (Lucide or Feather) with the defined `text.secondary` or `brand.primary` colors.
Never use placehold.it or similar dummy image services. Use ONLY the URLs provided in the `media` array above.
